scope: Private intake and current-runtime startup preflight; no training, final evaluation, automatic admission or engine policy changes

labelFormat.state: unknown, weak or reviewed; reviewed is required for preflight completeness
labelFormat.value: Explicit truth, including null or unknown when these describe the message; missing annotation is different
labelFormat.reviewerType: human for independent-truth review; assistant-only labels remain weak evidence
labelFormat.basis: source_text, owner_context, policy or not_stated; never model_output
labelFormat.evidence: Nonempty rationale/reference supporting this exact field; ownership must not be inferred from a name
labelFormat.textSha256: Exact source text hash binding the review; copied or stale labels are held

reviewFormat: reviewer, evidence, textSha256; binds a declaration to exact source text, not proof of authenticity
intakeLimits: All record and batch eligibility flags remain false; preflight completeness never grants admission or permission to score.
Unknown ownership is valid reviewed truth and must not be relabeled as P2P or own accounts.
Generated, unknown-origin and development/Gemini-exposed records remain held.
Content/proxy matches are holds for review, never proof of generation parentage or a verified family.
Existing reservations must not be opened or repurposed.
Zero/signed movement and ingestion deduplication policies remain unresolved; no new runtime policy is inferred.

runtime.typescript: Call MasroofEngine.init(parsed pinned weights) before detailed or ownership assessment that can use fallback scoring.
runtime.python: MasroofEngine() loads the pinned weights in its constructor; do not substitute a different model path implicitly.
runtime.currentMissingInit: TypeScript detailed fallback returns false without weights; strong structural evidence can still return an assessment. This is not proof of complete readiness.
runtime.currentInvalidInit: The legacy TypeScript init assigns the object without schema validation; a later fallback call can throw.
runtime.proposedBoundary: Validate pinned bytes and finite model structure before calling init; define explicit caller failure behavior before adding a runtime guard.
